recipes.name: Chai Hot Chocolate
instructions: Add all of the ingredients to a saucepan over medium-high heat. Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring throughout to avoid burning.
When hot, pour through a sieve and serve in your favourite mugs.
Top with whipped cream if desired. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter.
Storage Store in a mason jar in the fridge for up to 2 days.
